863e0183.text:
To face Frostmaw, you must entice him with the meat of his favorite prey.

Go to the Alterac Mountains in Azeroth and hunt a hulking mountain lion.  Kill it, and then take its carcass to the Growless Cave, a place held sacred by the bestial wendigo.

Place the carcass on the Flame of Uzel and the scent from burning meat will drift from the cave.

And then, in time, Frostmaw will come.
863e0183.title: Kodo Skin Scroll

f3ab30b0.text:
Agasham,

Our plans must be kept secret at all costs! It will be disasterous if the other tauren tribes discover our affiliation.

Signed,

Harbinger Elm
f3ab30b0.title: Secret Note #1

10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10537|c27b3101.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
10537|c27b3101.text: We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $N.

11116|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Abeqwa
11116|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3433|ac5dfa0b.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|ac5dfa0b.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and $r cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

4046|d98be16b.name: Magatha Grimtotem
4046|d98be16b.text: You must listen, young $c.  Listen to the whisperings in the darkness, for they offer guidance in these troubled times.

4877|fe134d60.name: Jandia
4877|fe134d60.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

1049-accept.name: Sage Truthseeker
1049-accept.text:
The Earthen Ring had pure intentions towards our plagued brethren. But who is to know the motivations of those whispering in the ears of the Elder Council?

The Forsaken whom we have allied with have a history wrought with deceit. Too hasty was our pact. Perhaps Cairne would have been wise to heed the warnings from Orgrimmar.

Deep within the Scarlet Monastery lies the Compendium of the Fallen, guarded by crazed human zealots. Their method is forged from insanity but their research might prove useful.
1049-accept.title: Compendium of the Fallen

1064-accept.name: Magatha Grimtotem
1064-accept.text:
The tauren have a bond with the land, and it pains me to hear of Stonetalon's plight.  But I fear that to heal the land, we must first remove the disease upon it.

Is it not fortunate, then, that the Forsaken are allied with us?  They know much of disease.  I believe they can aid us, and by doing so they will strengthen the trust between our people.

Speak with Apothecary Zamah.  She is a scholar and an emissary of the Forsaken.  You will find her in the Pools of Vision below the Spirit Rise.
1064-accept.title: Forsaken Aid

1064-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
1064-complete.text:
Magatha sent word of your coming, $N.  Although my heart beats no longer, I still feel sorrow for the spirits of Stonetalon.

The Forsaken are eager to offer what help we can.
1064-complete.title: Forsaken Aid

1065-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
1065-accept.text:
To rid Stonetalon of the Venture Company, we must take extreme measures.  Extreme, but without bloodshed.

A colleague of mine may have just the tool we need.  His name is Lydon; he dwells in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, in the distant land of Lordaeron.

To reach Hillsbrad, travel by zeppelin to our capital, the Undercity.  Then go north to Tirisfal Glades, southwest to Silverpine, and south to Hillsbrad.

Seek Lydon and bring him this note.  It details our needs to him.
1065-accept.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1102-accept.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-accept.text:
Cairne is a noble leader for uniting our people here on Thunder Bluff.

But I cannot forgive those who drove us from our ancestral lands as easily as some. My people inhabited the southern Barrens for decades. The land was holy to us. But we were driven off by numerous foes.

A vengeful fate awaits the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who musters a foul army from within Razorfen Kraul.

Bring me Razorflank's heart and I can die in peace, $N.
1102-accept.title: A Vengeful Fate

1131-complete.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-complete.text:
In defeating the creature Steelsnap, you have cleansed the Thousand Needles of a horrible taint.

And that, $N, is your lesson this day.
1131-complete.title: Steelsnap

1131-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-progress.text: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, $N?
1131-progress.title: Steelsnap

1136-accept.name: Melor Stonehoof
1136-accept.text:
$N, it is now time for you to travel to far-off lands.  You are ready.

You now hunt Frostmaw, a yeti in the Alterac Mountains.  He is elusive, his white coat blending into the snows of his mountain home.  He rarely shows himself.

But I will show you how to entice a creature such as he.  Here, take this scroll.  On it I have written how Frostmaw may be lured.

Now go, $N.  Your journey is long and many challenges lay waiting.  When you return with Frostmaw's mane, only then is your task complete.
1136-accept.title: Frostmaw

1153-complete.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-complete.text:
A good sample, $N. A good sample indeed.

Those travelers can no longer lord over me the ore they found, now that you have been successful.

I shall get to work on it immediately. If it proves strong enough, I will send a weapon crafted from the material back to the warchief to show him our success.

I shall not forget your help, $c.
1153-complete.title: A New Ore Sample

1153-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-progress.text:
I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.
1153-progress.title: A New Ore Sample

1195-complete.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-complete.text: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.
1195-complete.title: The Sacred Flame

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1196-accept.text:
Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.

I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
1196-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-complete.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1196-complete.text: Hm, yes, this phial of water will serve our purposes perfectly. Because of the shared ancestry of the dryads and the centaurs, the water of the moonwells will enable us to breach the protection of the eternal flame surrounding the centaur relic.
1196-complete.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1196-progress.text: I don't suppose you've been sent by Zangen, hm?
1196-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1197-accept.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1197-accept.text:
Using the water you brought, you will be able to temporarily douse the flame that holds the centaur relic. It will not work permanently, however, so you will have to be quick about it.

You will find Splithoof Crag, the centaurs' stronghold, to the north of here. The flame is kept in Splithoof Hold, a heavily guarded part of the crag.

Be careful, though, the Galak centaur have great numbers here, and will be rather reluctant to surrender something so dear to them.
1197-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

1197-complete.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1197-complete.text:
I sense a strange energy emanating from the Hoof... I have no doubt that we will discover surprising new information about the centaur from its study.

My thanks, $N. Now I must begin to decipher the mysteries you have brought to me.
1197-complete.title: The Sacred Flame

1197-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1197-progress.text: I am eager to put my hands upon the Cloven Hoof. Have you taken it yet?
1197-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

4542-complete.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-complete.text: More bad news! These centaurs have gone too far! They raided one of my supply caravans and slaughtered the whole party. This is an outrage, and it will not go unpunished!
4542-complete.title: Message to Freewind Post

4542-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-progress.text: What do you want, $c? An urgent message - for me?
4542-progress.title: Message to Freewind Post

4767-accept.name: Elu
4767-accept.text:
I've been tasked to recruit more wyverns for the master wind riders. Their numbers are growing and I myself hope to become a wind rider one day. However, we cannot train enough wyverns to keep up with the demand. Perhaps you can help me, $N.

I need you to travel to Highperch to gather some wyvern eggs. From here, head northwest along the canyon walls to a ramp that will lead you into Highperch. Be careful, wyverns are very protective over their eggs and they will not be kind to intruders.
4767-accept.title: Wind Rider

4821-accept.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-accept.text:
A rumor has surfaced about an alien egg here in Thousand Needles. Those that report seeing this egg have failed to even get close enough to examine it in detail. Serpents guard the egg as if it's one of their own.

I want you to seek out this alien egg and bring it to me so that I may examine it. Reports say the egg is located within a serpent den, but there are several serpent dens along the base of the cliff walls south and northeast of Freewind Post.
4821-accept.title: Alien Egg

4821-complete.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-complete.text: Yes, finally... the mysterious egg has finally been delivered to me. Now, let me take a closer look at this... What..! What is this..?
4821-complete.title: Alien Egg

4821-progress.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-progress.text: I must know more about this mysterious egg, who knows what will hatch from it.
4821-progress.title: Alien Egg

4841-accept.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4841-accept.text: $N, I entreat you to hunt these centaur down. They shall feel the wrath of our revenge. Attack the centaur camp to the north of Freewind Post!  Let wrath guide your hand!
4841-accept.title: Pacify the Centaur

4841-complete.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4841-complete.text: For my gratitude, this is for you, $N.
4841-complete.title: Pacify the Centaur

4865-accept.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4865-accept.text:
If I did not see that with my own eyes I would never have believed it to be true. Vengeance has come to Thousand Needles!

<Hagar wipes his brow.>

$N, you must act quickly! Go now and seek out Motega Firemane; he is located at Whitereach Post just northwest of Freewind Post along the road. He will know what to do!
4865-accept.title: Serpent Wild

4865-complete.name: Motega Firemane
4865-complete.text: Vengeance! So, the legend of Arikara is true. Indeed, this is a problem that must be resolved immediately.
4865-complete.title: Serpent Wild

4904-complete.name: Thalia Amberhide
4904-complete.text: Thank you, $N. Deep in my bones I knew that she would find her way back to me. She told me of your bravery and how you helped her escape. These items belonged to her brother. I know she would want you to have them.
4904-complete.title: Free at Last

5062-accept.name: Motega Firemane
5062-accept.text:
Arikara is a deadly creature that must be dealt with swiftly. In order to hunt her down you will need to light the sacred fire of life - this will summon Arikara.

Go now and harvest the rare Incendia agave plant. Once you have harvested enough agave, seek council with Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. She is a powerful $c that can enchant the agave plant to create a powder that will light the fire.

Travel northeast to the Boiling Pool and gather Incendia Agave.
5062-accept.title: Sacred Fire

5062-complete.name: Magatha Grimtotem
5062-complete.text:
Good, you have gathered the essential amount of Incendia agave. This rare herb found only in Thousand Needles will help light the dormant sacred fire of life.

<Magatha begins to enchant the Incendia agave.>
5062-complete.title: Sacred Fire

5062-progress.name: Magatha Grimtotem
5062-progress.text:
So, Motega Firemain sends word of Arikara...well now that is grave news.

<Magatha looks around.>

Arikara is a deadly creature born only to seek vengeance against those who have committed heinous acts.

<Magatha smiles.>
5062-progress.title: Sacred Fire

5064-accept.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5064-accept.text:
$N, you have served us well in the past, so I now entrust to you an important mission. The Grimtotem Clan is up to something secretive. Three agents of unknown origin were seen visiting the Grimtotem over the recent weeks. We discovered that separate chests in Darkcloud Pinnacle hold these guarded messages.

$N, if you succeed in this dangerous mission, I will reward you in kind.
5064-accept.title: Grimtotem Spying

5064-complete.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5064-complete.text:
Great Spirit Totem! This is dire news indeed. I must begin to plan for whatever may come.

$N, as promised, here is your reward for your brave service.
5064-complete.title: Grimtotem Spying

5064-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5064-progress.text: Have you discovered what the Grimtotem are up to?
5064-progress.title: Grimtotem Spying

5088-accept.name: Magatha Grimtotem
5088-accept.text:
Take this refined and purified Incendia Powder to Thousand Needles and toss it on the sacred fire of life. It is located in the Darkcloud Pinnacle on an isolated needle where they bury their dead.

The enchantment that I have weaved into the Incendia powder will summon Arikara to you, $N.

I fear she may be stalking Cairne Bloodhoof; too much Tauren lore has changed, and I fear this has angered Arikara. Move quickly before all is lost, $c!
5088-accept.title: Arikara

5147-accept.name: Unknown
5147-accept.text:
Wanted: Arnak Grimtotem

Arnak the outcast is wanted for the heinous crimes of murder and kidnapping. Handsome rewards will be given to those brave enough to bring this criminal to justice.

Arnak was last seen on the cliffs near the Darkcloud Pinnacle. Show the proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post in order to claim the reward.
5147-accept.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

5147-complete.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5147-complete.text:
Hah! Well, this is excellent news! I was starting to think that he would never be brought to justice!

Here you are, $N... and thanks. News of Arnak's foul deeds boiled my blood!
5147-complete.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

5147-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5147-progress.text: Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?
5147-progress.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

5151-accept.name: Wizlo Bearingshiner
5151-accept.text:
I am the only survivor from our caravan attack by the centaur! A rare yet mighty panther is guarding my best gizmo, which is around his neck. Hah! Even the centaur tremble in the presence of this ferocious beast!

Here is the key to the cage. They took everything there, but left him alone. Slay this beast and bring back my hypercapacitor, and I shall reward you.

The wrecked caravan is just north of here.
5151-accept.title: Hypercapacitor Gizmo

98069-accept.name: Jandia
98069-accept.text:
Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.
98069-accept.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98070-accept.name: Jandia
98070-accept.text:
The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
98070-accept.title: Stop the Screeching
